ConnectionStrings._comment: PostgresConnection comes from the Render env var ConnectionStrings__PostgresConnection. Deliberately absent here: a committed localhost fallback meant a missing env var booted the app pointing at a database that doesn't exist in production — serving 500s on every DB endpoint instead of failing fast at startup (Program.cs throws when this is missing). Local dev gets its copy from appsettings.Development.json.

AppLinks._comment: Used by the public /space/{id} invite page and /.well-known/assetlinks.json. Set as Render env vars (AppLinks__IosStoreUrl etc). IosStoreUrl needs the numeric App Store id, which only exists once the app is published — leave blank until then and the iOS install button simply won't render. AndroidSha256Fingerprints is a comma-separated list of the app-signing cert SHA-256 fingerprints from the EAS/Play Console; without it Android App Links can't verify and https invite links always open the browser instead of the app.

Cors._comment: Cross-origin callers allowed to read API responses. Empty/absent falls back to Expo web's localhost dev ports (see Program.cs). The mobile app needs NO entry here — React Native sends no Origin header and CORS is browser-only. Add an entry only if you deploy an actual web build, via Render env vars Cors__AllowedOrigins__0, Cors__AllowedOrigins__1, ...

Omdb._comment: OMDb API key comes from the Render env var Omdb__ApiKey (double underscore → maps to Omdb:ApiKey). Keep this blank — never commit a key here.

CineMind._comment: Set both as Render env vars: CineMind__PuzzleSalt and CineMind__AdminSecret (double underscore). Keep both blank here. PuzzleSalt: without it the daily puzzle is still deterministic but becomes guessable in advance. AdminSecret: gates POST /api/game/catalog/seed (header x-admin-secret) — pick any random string.
